# Generator Status

> Work out your RCRA hazardous waste generator category from your monthly waste amounts, see the accumulation limits that apply, and train your staff on generator rules.

Generator Status (https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs RCRA Generator Training, RCRA Generator Refresher, Satellite Accumulation Areas, Contingency Plan & Emergency Coordinator or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). The full generator course: determinations, accumulation, manifests and training. Enroll: https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Refresher Training](https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training): $59.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA, annual). The annual refresher for LQG personnel and anyone who needs an update. Enroll: https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-refresher-training?buy=600
- [Hazardous Waste Satellite Accumulation Area Training](https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training): $59.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262.15. Rules for waste collected at the point of generation. Enroll: https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-satellite-accumulation-area-training?buy=415
- [Hazardous Waste Contingency Plan and Emergency Coordinator Training](https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 40 CFR Parts 262 and 264/265. Contingency plans and the emergency coordinator role for LQGs. Enroll: https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-contingency-plan-and-emergency-coordinator-training?buy=412
- [Hazardous Waste Manifest Training](https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 262 Subpart B (RCRA). Filling out and tracking the manifest for every shipment. Enroll: https://generator-status.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazardous-waste-manifest-training?buy=580
